<?php

$numbers = [
    '688126340316', '0128469655154', '92181914514156', '177332430060552', '7982377590420309',
    '9884593615513906',
];
foreach ($numbers as $number) {
    $total = 0;
    for ($position = 1; $position <= strlen($number); $position++) {
        $digit = (int) $number[strlen($number) - $position];
        if ($position % 2 === 0) {
            $digit *= 2;
            if ($digit > 9) {
                $digit -= 9;
            }
        }
        $total += $digit;
    }
    if ($total % 10 === 0) {
        printf("%s: valid\n", $number);
    } else {
        $expected = (10 - ($total - (int) $number[strlen($number) - 1]) % 10) % 10;
        printf("%s: invalid (expected check digit %d)\n", $number, $expected);
    }
}
